description: Read a previously created quote using its actual quoteId, quoteHash or quoteUrl. Requires a current signed traveler assertion, verified legacy session, or the still-valid USED QUOTE handoff that created this exact quote. A quote is not a booking or inventory hold. Returns stored prices and payment terms; never substitute another room's payment schedule.

agentHandoffId.description: Still-valid USED QUOTE handoff that created this quote. Read-only access grants no additional writes; expired handoffs require fresh traveler verification.

quoteUrl.description: Existing ATA /stays/quote/ link supplied by the traveler or returned by create_quote.

travelerAssertion.description: Current signed ATA traveler assertion for the quote owner.

name: get_quote_details
